title: Fattoush
description: A bread salad built to use up flatbread that has gone stale. Sumac and pomegranate molasses do the work; the pita has to stay crisp until it reaches the table.
notes: Dress it at the table, not in the kitchen. Fattoush has a working life of about four minutes.

ingredients.name: pita breads
ingredients.note: stale, torn into pieces and toasted crisp

steps.text: Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, pomegranate molasses, and half the sumac with a good pinch of salt.
Combine the tomatoes, Persian cucumbers, radishes, spring onions, parsley, and mint in a wide bowl.
steps.tip: Cut everything to roughly the same size so no one component dominates a forkful.

steps.text: Add the toasted pita breads and pour over the dressing.
Toss once, dust with the remaining sumac, and take it straight to the table.
